title: Mouth sores in a child (stomatitis)
what: These are painful sores or white patches in a child's mouth. The doctor looks for the cause and chooses the treatment.
why: When a child complains of mouth pain, eats poorly, and sores are visible on the tongue, cheeks or gums.
duration: the visit usually takes 15 to 30 minutes; sores usually heal in 1 to 2 weeks
tell_doctor: When the sores appeared and how many there are
How much your child eats and drinks
Whether anyone at home is sick

prepare.title: Drinks
prepare.text: Before the visit, give your child drinks more often, in small sips.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Offer soft, cool food with nothing sour or salty.

bring: A list of medicines already given
steps: The doctor asks how the symptoms started
Looks at the mouth, tongue, gums and throat
Sometimes checks the skin and takes the temperature
Explains how to treat the mouth and what to give for pain
feel: The exam usually does not hurt, but your child may not like opening the mouth
Eating and drinking hurts, especially sour and hot things
after: Offer drinks often, even little by little
Soft, cool food, nothing sour, spicy or hot
Separate dishes and towel for your child
Treat the mouth as the doctor prescribed
red_flags: Your child hardly drinks, passes urine rarely, is limp
Sores do not heal after more than 2 weeks, or there are more and more

faq.a: Sometimes. It depends on the cause. The doctor will say whether to keep other children away.

faq.q: Can my child go to kindergarten?
faq.a: Usually not while your child is sick and has a fever. Ask the doctor.

reminders.text: Visit about your child's mouth sores tomorrow. Offer drinks often and bring a list of medicines.
